@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: 'Fork: key the MLXLanguageModel cache by id and revision, then bump Package.resolved'
+---
+Plan: `model-pool.md` §1.4, §2.6.
+
+## What
+In the fork `swissarmyhammer/mlx-swift-lm` (branch `stable`, checked out under `IntegrationTests/.build/checkouts/mlx-swift-lm`), `MLXLanguageModel.modelID` is `configuration.name`, which is the repo id alone. The process-global `ModelCache` in `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift` is keyed by that id, so two configurations for one repo at two revisions share one `ModelContainer`. The second caller gets the first revision's weights.
+
+- In the fork, make `MLXLanguageModel.modelID` include the revision when it is not `"main"`: `"\(id)@\(revision)"`. Keep `ModelConfiguration.name` unchanged so download paths and `MLXDownloadProgress` reporting do not change.
+- Audit every use of `modelID` in the fork: `ModelCache` keys, `ExecutorPromptCacheStore`, availability (`modelExistsOnDisk`, `weightsLocation(modelID)`), and progress. `weightsLocation` must receive a value it can resolve to a directory. If it receives `modelID`, pass `configuration.name` there instead.
+- Here in this package: check `LiveModelLoader.weightsLocation` (`Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Resolution/LiveModelLoader.swift`) still resolves after the change, then bump `Package.resolved` and `IntegrationTests/Package.resolved` to the new fork revision.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] In the fork, two `MLXLanguageModel` values for one id at two revisions get two cache entries and two containers.
+- [ ] In the fork, `evict()` on one revision leaves the other revision cached.
+- [ ] `Package.resolved` here pins the fork revision that carries the fix.
+- [ ] `swift test` and `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests` are green here.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Fork: new test in `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/MLXLanguageModelTests.swift` that two configurations `(id: "org/repo", revision: "a")` and `(id: "org/repo", revision: "b")` produce two distinct `modelID` values and two `loadContainer()` calls on a stub loader.
+- [ ] Fork: `swift test --filter MLXLanguageModelTests` → all pass.
+- [ ] Here: `swift test` → all pass. `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests` → all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #model-pool #defect
\ No newline at end of file

+- [ ] Fork: new test in `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/MLXLanguageModelTests.swift`, placed under the `@Suite(.serialized)` parent that `ModelCacheEvictionTests` documents (the cache is one process-global `static let`): configurations `(id: "org/repo", revision: "a")` and `(id: "org/repo", revision: "b")` give two distinct `modelID` values and two `loadContainer()` calls on a stub loader; `evict()` on one leaves the other.
 - [ ] Fork: `swift test --filter MLXLanguageModelTests` → all pass.
